breakdown.description: The follower pressures on the two holes are replaced by dead loads based on reference normals
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly instructs to use reference (undeformed) normals for the hole pressure loads ('using the reference (undeformed) hole normals', 'N is the FEniCS FacetNormal on the reference mesh'), which is the dead load approach from the incomplete prompt. The ground truth requires true follower pressure using the current normals of the deformed hole boundaries. The agent repeated the original error rather than correcting it.
